Subject: Post-call: On-prem / air-gapped deployment recap & hardware questions

Patricia — thanks for taking time today. Quick recap from our call and the asks we committed to: 

Summary of your needs
- Primary requirement: Private, on-prem (air-gapped) deployment behind customer-managed network for sensitive genomic ML workloads.
- Secondary interest: Redwood Dedicated as a temporary staging/pilot while on-prem environment is commissioned.
- Constraints: No outbound internet from the inference nodes; patch windows must be scheduled and approved by EdgeBio ops; strict data-retention policies.

Open technical questions (please confirm):
1) Hardware baseline: do you have a preferred GPU vendor (NVIDIA A100 vs H100) and the counts you want to start with? We asked for an initial target of 4 GPUs for the pilot.
2) Storage & NVMe layout: will the inference hosts have dedicated NVMe local disk, or do you prefer NFS-attached storage?
3) Upgrade cadence: how frequently can we schedule allowed maintenance windows (quarterly vs monthly)? Who signs off?
4) Air-gap logistics: can you provide a local build server or jumpbox we can ship artifacts to, or will you manage image ingestion via an offline USB/airgap process?

Next steps we proposed
- Grace (SE) will draft a short on-prem checklist and minimal HW spec to validate feasibility (attached).
- Marcus will scope a pilot run on Redwood Dedicated for 4xA100-equivalent capacity for 4 weeks while EdgeBio provision the on-prem hosts.
- Priyom to coordinate procurement/legal contacts and capture timeline and PO info.

Deliverables by Friday 2026-02-13:
- SE checklist (Grace)
- Pilot cost estimate (Marcus)
- High-level deployment runbook and offline-install options (Priyom)

Thanks again — if anything above is off, flag it and I'll update.

Best,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Hi Patricia / Priyom — attaching the checklist I referenced on the call (rdw-private-deploy-checklist.xlsx). Highlights and technical notes below.

Minimum recommended configuration (pilot):
- Compute: 4x A100 80GB or 4x H100 80GB (A100 is fine if H100 not available; H100 gives ~20–30% perf uplift on large models).
- RAM: 1.5–2TB system RAM across hosts if you plan to run model shards locally; for single-host inference 512GB+ is acceptable.
- Storage: NVMe for model cache (1–2TB per GPU) + 4TB NFS for artifacts/logs.
- Network: Private layer 2/3; no egress. Recommendation: a jumpbox with controlled egress for admin image ingestion.

Offline upgrade options we support:
- Air-gap bundle: we provide signed image bundles and a one-time verification script. EdgeBio ops can push via an approved jumpbox or USB medium.
- Manual patching: we provide detailed step-by-step upgrade playbooks and a dry-run mode.

Questions for your infra team (short):
- Will you accept signed binaries/images from Redwood (we can provide SHA256 and signatures)?
- Do you have an HSM/KMS integration on-prem for key storage?

I'll stand by to review the infra drawing once you send it.

Grace O'Connor
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Post-call: On-prem / air-gapped deployment recap & hardware questions

Thanks — confirming a few items and attaching our infra diagram (edgebio-infra-dwg.pdf). Answers inline below.

>>> Hardware baseline: vendor and counts
We currently run a mixed GPU estate. For the pilot we can provision 4xA100 40GB nodes (no H100 available until Q2 provisioning). We can provide 2x hosts with 2 GPUs each or a single host with 4 GPUs depending on space.

>>> Storage & NVMe layout
We have 1TB NVMe per node available for scratch, plus access to a central NFS cluster. Prefer to use local NVMe for KV cache and NFS for longer-term artifacts.

>>> Upgrade cadence and sign-off
EdgeBio ops will allow a quarterly maintenance window for vendor-scheduled upgrades. Patching outside the window requires explicit approval from my director (cc'd in procurement chain).

>>> Air-gap logistics
We operate via an internal jumpbox. We can receive signed image bundles on the jumpbox and apply images internally. We do not accept removable media unless under strict audit — prefer the jumpbox path.

Timeline & budget
- Preferred pilot start: 2026-03-01.
- Targeting production cutover for first use-case: 2026-06-01 (conservative).
- Budget: initial pilot budget approved ~$45k for Professional Services + temporary Dedicated capacity costs.

Attaching: edgebio-infra-dwg.pdf

Patricia Gomez
Head of Infrastructure
EdgeBio Therapeutics
